verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a developer API platform like Twilio, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a Twilio CLI. The pack shows only the REST APIs over HTTPS, language SDKs, Console no-code flows and an official MCP server, which are different features and do not count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
